llms.body:
# Moloco

> Moloco brings the power of AI advertising to the open internet, helping apps and retailers grow customers at global scale. Moloco's compound AI advertising system, CARA, powers two products: Moloco Ads, for mobile app growth, and Moloco Commerce Media, for retailers and marketplaces building retail media businesses.

Moloco was founded in 2013. Its advertising intelligence makes real-time decisions across more than a trillion ad opportunities a day. Moloco Ads reaches 2B+ daily active users and powers campaigns for 45 of the world's 50 highest-grossing mobile app publishers. Moloco Commerce Media serves 97,000+ advertisers across retail media programs powered by Moloco.

This site is available in English, French, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Vietnamese and German. Localized pages use the language code as a prefix, for example https://www.moloco.com/fr/moloco-commerce-media.

## Products

- [Moloco Ads](https://www.moloco.com/moloco-ads): AI advertising for every kind of app and every stage of the customer lifecycle. Acquire, re-engage and monetize users with a compound AI system built for every app category.
- [Moloco Commerce Media](https://www.moloco.com/moloco-commerce-media): AI-driven retail media and commerce media platform for retailers and marketplaces. Helps retailers and marketplaces build and scale an advertising business, grow ad revenue as a percentage of GMV (A2G), and improve discovery for shoppers.
- [Moloco Next](https://www.moloco.com/moloco-next): A preview of what is coming next in AI advertising, including new products, research and ideas for growth teams.

## Moloco Ads: capabilities

- [User Acquisition](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-ads/user-acquisition): Find high-value users at global scale with a compound AI ad system built for performance user acquisition.
- [Re-engagement](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-ads/re-engagement): Re-engage existing app users to drive repeat actions, revenue and retention.
- [Performance CTV](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-ads/performance-ctv): Connected TV buying built to drive installs, actions and revenue, measured as a performance channel.
- [Moloco SDK](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-ads/sdk): For app publishers. Open your inventory to global demand and AI-powered bidding to monetize your app.

## Moloco Ads: technology

- [CARA for Moloco Ads](https://www.moloco.com/technology/moloco-ads/cara): CARA is Moloco's compound ad recommendation architecture, the advertising intelligence behind Moloco Ads.

## Moloco Ads: industries

- [Mobile Gaming](https://www.moloco.com/industries/moloco-ads/mobile-gaming): User acquisition, re-engagement and monetization across the full player lifecycle for mobile games.
- [Finance](https://www.moloco.com/industries/moloco-ads/finance): Performance advertising for fintech and finance apps, focused on customers who fund, transact and stay.
- [iGaming and Prediction Markets](https://www.moloco.com/industries/moloco-ads/igaming): Performance advertising for iGaming, sportsbook and prediction market apps, focused on deposits, not just downloads.
- [On-Demand Services](https://www.moloco.com/industries/moloco-ads/on-demand-services): Acquire and re-engage high-value customers for on-demand and marketplace apps.
- [Agencies](https://www.moloco.com/industries/moloco-ads/agencies): Moloco Ads for agencies: AI advertising built to deliver measurable outcomes for agency clients.

## Moloco Commerce Media: capabilities

- [Simplified Ad Ops](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-commerce-media/simplified-ad-ops): Run retail media with less operational work. Simplifies campaign setup, trafficking and optimization for in-house teams.
- [Ad Formats and Capabilities](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-commerce-media/ad-formats-and-capabilities): Retail ad formats, from onsite placements to offsite demand, built for advertiser performance.
- [AI Engine](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-commerce-media/ai-engine): The AI engine that scores every auction to improve discovery, conversion and retailer revenue.
- [Agentic Commerce](https://www.moloco.com/capabilities/moloco-commerce-media/agentic-commerce): Helps retail media businesses prepare for agentic commerce, when AI agents as well as shoppers discover and buy.

## Moloco Commerce Media: technology

- [CARA for Commerce Media](https://www.moloco.com/technology/moloco-commerce-media/cara-for-mcm): CARA powers Moloco Commerce Media with advertising intelligence that improves discovery, performance and retailer revenue.

## Customers

- [Customer Stories](https://www.moloco.com/customers): Customer stories from apps and retailers across gaming, finance, on-demand and commerce media.
- [Scopely: Monopoly GO!](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/scopely-monopoly-go): Mobile gaming user acquisition case study.
- [King](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/open-mic-open-internet-king): Mobile gaming case study.
- [Bravestars](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/bravestarsgames): Mobile gaming growth case study using Moloco UA and the Moloco SDK.
- [ReelShort](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/reelshort): Dual ROAS campaigns optimizing for in-app purchases and ad revenue.
- [BevMo](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/bevmo): First performance CTV test.
- [FREENOW](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/freenow): On-demand mobility app case study.
- [Nexon](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/nexon-sees-incremental-impact-of-moloco-performance-ctv): Performance CTV incrementality case study.
- [Musinsa](https://www.moloco.com/case-studies/musinsa-ads-mcm): Fashion platform using Moloco Ads and Moloco Commerce Media.

## Research and resources

- [Research and Reports](https://www.moloco.com/research): Original Moloco research on mobile gaming, AI disruption and performance marketing.
- [Blog](https://www.moloco.com/blog): Ideas, data and playbooks on app growth, retail media and AI advertising.
- [Events](https://www.moloco.com/events): Upcoming conferences and webinars, plus recaps of events Moloco hosts and attends.
- [Help Center](https://www.moloco.com/help-center): Guides for Moloco Ads: campaign setup, performance analysis, partner integrations and product updates.
- [Moloco Ads Developer Hub](https://developer.moloco.cloud/docs/getting-started): Moloco Ads API documentation and getting-started guides.
- [Moloco Commerce Media Docs](https://mcm-docs.moloco.com/docs/what-is-moloco-mcm): Documentation for Moloco Commerce Media, covering Sponsored Product, Sponsored Display and Sponsored Brands campaign types.

## Company

- [About Moloco](https://www.moloco.com/company/about): Company overview, mission and global footprint.
- [Leadership](https://www.moloco.com/company/leadership): Executive team and leadership.
- [Newsroom](https://www.moloco.com/company/newsroom): Press releases and company news, including the Global Agency Partner Program.
- [Careers](https://www.moloco.com/company/careers): Open roles, life at Moloco and how Moloco hires. Includes internships.
- [Contact Us](https://www.moloco.com/contact-us): Talk to the Moloco team.

## Policies and legal

- [Terms of Use](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/terms-of-use): Terms governing access to Moloco websites and online properties.
- [Website Privacy Notice](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/website-privacy-notice): How Moloco collects, uses and shares information when you visit moloco.com.
- [Advertising Services Privacy Notice](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/advertising-privacy-notice): Privacy notice for Moloco advertising services.
- [Privacy Portal](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/privacy-portal): Submit a privacy request to access, delete or manage personal data.
- [Brand Safety Policy](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/brand-safety-policy): How Moloco protects advertisers, publishers and users across Moloco Ads and Moloco Commerce Media.
- [Security and Trust](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/security): Security practices and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Ethics and Compliance](https://www.moloco.com/compliance): Moloco's ethics and compliance program and how to raise a concern.
- [Equal Employment Opportunity](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/equal-employment-opportunity): Equal employment opportunity statement and notices.
- [Supplier Portal](https://www.moloco.com/terms-and-policies/supplier-portal): Requirements and resources for Moloco suppliers.

## Sitemap

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.moloco.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of pages on moloco.com.

The hardest problem in advertising happens a trillion times a day

One person, one moment, and less than a second to decide what they see and what it’s worth. Moloco builds for that decision across millions of independent apps, connected TVs, and the digital storefronts where people arrive ready to buy.

These companies choose Moloco

Growth is moving, and advertising needs to move with it

Performance advertising is moving: onto new surfaces, into new markets, beyond the platforms that once defined it. This is where attention exists and where it’s growing.

There are limits to what’s possible with the primary big tech platforms. We're pushing the frontier to new surfaces including in-app, CTV, and commerce media, and helping performance marketers provide new paths to scaled growth.

2B+
Daily active users reached by Moloco Ads. {[data-attribute="init-tooltip"][tooltip-content="<p>Source:<br><br>Daily active users (DAU), for the purposes of this claim, is defined as the average number of unique consumer devices observed across Moloco`s integrated exchange partners and proprietary SDK on Android and iOS devices globally per business day. Based on a Moloco internal estimate of potential daily user reach across an average of five sample business days in March and April 2026. Each device is assigned to a single country to prevent double-counting; tablets are excluded through deterministic classification using exchange signals and device model matching; and country-specific device-to-user calibration factors are applied to translate device counts to estimated unique users.</p>"]}

Moloco ads
Moloco Commerce media

Where do you want to grow?

Moloco offers two different AI-native platforms: Moloco Ads for performance marketers ready to reach more people, and Moloco Commerce Media for retailers ready to build a scalable advertising business.

Moloco Ads

For performance marketers

Acquire and retain customers across 2.9 million independent apps, using AI-driven relevance to reach the people most likely to convert, optimized toward the outcomes you define: ROAS, LTV, re-engagement. {[data-attribute="init-tooltip"][tooltip-content="<p>Source:<br><br>Moloco Internal Data; count of distinct app bundles (iOS and Android cumulative total) where Moloco received at least RTB (real time bid) request in the 90-day period ending April 3, 2026, worldwide. ‘Independent’ refers to apps not operated by Walled Gardens (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon Shopping, YouTube).</p>"]}

https://media.ffycdn.net/us/moloco/3c4C4PKCkVaDsCwaVe8w.mp4?width=2400&format=mp4

Moloco Commerce Media

For retailers and marketplaces

Turn shopper behavior into an advertising business, using AI-driven relevance to connect advertisers with shoppers at the moment of shopping intent.

https://media.ffycdn.net/us/moloco/W1TPzzgbcEHu4UmrxEUf.mp4?width=2400&format=mp4

CARA, Moloco’s AI system

Moloco’s founders built the advertising systems inside the world’s largest technology companies, then left in 2013 to bring that capability to everyone else. CARA, the Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture, is the result of that effort.

CARA coordinates models, agents, and specialized software across every technical domain of advertising. Because it compounds, an improvement in one domain strengthens every other: the ground gained becomes the foundation for the next.

See CARA for Moloco Ads and CARA for Moloco Commerce Media to find out more about how this compound AI goes to work for advertisers and retailers.

An AI advertising system that gets smarter with every campaign

Strong performance is built on moments of discovery

AI advertising helps people discover the right product, service, or brand at the right moment. Better discovery is better for everyone. Customers find what matters, advertisers perform better, and retailers create more value, as demonstrated in the customer growth stories below.

Double-digit growth in display ad revenue as a % of GMV (A2G) over the past 12 months {[data-attribute="init-tooltip"][tooltip-content="<p>Source:<br><br>Customer provided data; analysis period: Q4 2024</p>"]}

“Wayfair needed an ad technology partner that could deliver real-time personalization across our catalog of millions of products while maximizing Return on Ad Spend for our suppliers. “Moloco's AI goes beyond surface-level metrics to identify the players who drive real business impact. Combined with a team that's deeply invested in our objectives and outcomes, our partnership with Moloco continues to get smarter and more effective over time.”

“Starting with our global launch and continuing today, Moloco has been a strong partner with an excellent ability to consistently find high-quality, highly-engaged players.”

Frequently Asked Questions

Who uses Moloco?

Moloco is used by mobile app marketers and retailers seeking measurable advertising growth.

Moloco Ads is built for performance marketers acquiring users across mobile apps and CTV. Moloco Commerce Media is built for retailers and marketplaces creating advertising businesses on their own digital properties. Global customers include Costco, TikTok, Pinterest, Revolut and Robinhood.

What does Moloco cost?

Moloco pricing depends on the product, campaign goals, market and level of advertising activity.

Moloco Ads uses performance-based campaign pricing, while Moloco Commerce Media is structured around the needs of each retailer or marketplace. Prospective customers can speak with Moloco to determine the commercial model that’s right for them.

How is Moloco Ads different to advertising on Google and Meta?

Google and Meta primarily sell ads across their own properties, while Moloco Ads can extend your reach across millions of independent apps. Teams typically run Moloco Ads alongside Google and Meta, not instead of them.

The frontier keeps moving. We move with it.

Moloco. Built for the hardest problems in advertising.
